sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Sablewood Hybrid Fauna: Sablewood fauna mix familiar animal shapes into unfamiliar pressures: Cat-Squirrels, Giraffe-Deer, Lemur-Toads, Fox-Bats, Horse-Goats, Bullfrogs, Strixwolves, Eeligators, and stranger deep-wood hybrids.
